external_dictionary_review.notes: Generation-stage senses use repository lexicon evidence; independent lexical approval remains separate.

freshness_method: Guarded promotion checks all selected IDs against canonical Urdu A1, A2, and B1 sequences 1-54 immediately before append.

targets.intended_sense: ability, aptitude, or capacity for a task
a gap or unmet need in a design/problem context
retired or leaving regular employment after a career
office, position, or formal role in an organization
invited or asked to attend by choice
truth or factual reality supported by evidence
concealment or a barrier preventing information from being seen
secrets or mysteries; unknown matters presented as hidden
track, route, or traceable sequence of locations/events
around or in the nearby surroundings
gentleness or softness of manner without surrendering a position
kindness expressed through respectful, useful behavior

generation_guardrails: P1-P5 introduce exactly three new targets each; P6 introduces none and visibly recycles all fifteen.
Unit 10 synthesizes B1 reasoning patterns across technology, work, information, travel/problem solving, and relationships rather than creating a new narrow topic silo.
All six passages retain ten questions and ten linked answers and remain within the 220-320 whitespace-token B1 band.
Learner-facing title, passage text, questions, and answers use Urdu script only.
Guarded promotion fails closed on freshness, schema drift, QA links, script leakage, first-introduction collisions, checkpoint recycling, or state mismatch.
B1 completion changes production frontier to B2 only; it does not imply educator/publication release approval.
